entities.summary: Antoine "Scoop" Jordan is an American professional basketball player. Antoine attended Siena College and played as their point guard from 2002 to 2005. He has played overseas in Italy, the Netherlands, Israel, Lithuania and Germany. In 2010 Antoine signed with BG Goettingen. He has a wife and two kids that reside in Maryland.
